test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 03 Jul, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: According to Census of India 2011, which of the following states recorded the least population?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sikkim**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sikkim** recorded the least population according to the Census of India 2011.
 
• The Census of India is conducted every ten years by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner, under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• It is one of the most comprehensive sources of demographic data in India, covering various aspects such as population size, density, distribution, and various socio-economic indicators.
 
• Sikkim, being a small state in the northeastern part of India, has a significantly lower population compared to other states like Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, and Punjab.
 
• The low population can be attributed to its geographical terrain, limited land area, and other demographic factors.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Census of India 2011** was the 15th National Census since 1871 and marked the first time biometric information was collected.
 
• The total population of India according to the 2011 Census was over 1.21 billion.
 
• States with larger populations typically have more urban centers and industrial activities compared to smaller states like Sikkim.
 
• Understanding population distribution is crucial for planning and development, policy formulation, and resource allocation by the government.
 
• The next Census of India is scheduled to be conducted in 2021, which will provide updated demographic data.
